state: On Aug 22, 2026 the US imposed a 50% tariff on ~$20B of Canadian imports, including Northern Bleached Softwood Kraft (NBSK) pulp, a key tissue fiber that is 15-30% of the blend in premium bath tissue and 50-65% in premium paper towels. NC State researchers estimate this raises manufacturing costs 11-20% for premium toilet tissue and 31-38% for premium paper towels. Procter & Gamble (maker of Charmin and Bounty) already announced mid-single-digit percentage price increases on about 25% of its US products, citing roughly $1B in FY2026 tariff-driven cost impact. Manufacturers are drawing down pre-tariff pulp inventory and existing supply contracts, which typically delays retail price pass-through by weeks to months. Costco is known for resisting supplier price hikes on private-label and staple items to protect member trust.
